instructions: EXAMPLE ONLY: proposed sizes and mounts below are NOT measured. Do not set measured=true until physically verifying each marker's printed black-square side length and full mount transform.

Calibrate fixed index 1 and wrist index 0 separately with scripts/calibrate_camera_intrinsics.py; supply existing calibration JSON containing camera_matrix, dist_coeffs and frame_size [width,height]. No intrinsic calibration files are shipped here.
Intrinsics paths are relative to this config file. Keep calibration resolution, focus and zoom unchanged during registration.
Use ArUco DICT_4X4_50: base=2, cube=0, bowl/container=1. Marker +X is right, +Y up on the printed marker, +Z out of its front; all translations below are meters.
base_from_marker maps base marker coordinates to SO101 mounting-base coordinates. Proposed flat mount: center [0,-0.10,0.03], yaw 0; measure against the physical base, not a guessed camera pose.

marker_from_object maps object-root coordinates into marker coordinates. Proposed centered cube-top marker: root center 27.5 mm below marker; 55 mm cube. Proposed bowl marker: table-contact root 3 mm below inner-bottom marker. Measure any lateral offset and yaw too.

Keep objects stationary and resting on the table. Each sample requires base and object together in the SAME image; reposition the wrist BETWEEN exposures until both objects have five valid samples from EACH camera. Cameras must be above table looking downward; no stale wrist extrinsics are used.

The scene base is world [0,0.3,0.72] yaw 0; table is world Z 0.75. Validate cube root base Z 0.0575 and bowl root Z 0.03. Output cube Z 0 is the existing rest_on_table sentinel; actual measured transforms remain in alignment metadata.
